title: 天文雷射導引星
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
summary: 以約 90 km 高的中氣層鈉層與 ESO VLT 4LGSF 的四道 22 W 鈉雷射為主軸，從 D2 線吸收截面推到每平方公尺每秒的回波光子數，再處理錐效應、無法由雷射量測的 tip-tilt、光點拉長、鈉層高度造成的假離焦與多雷射互擾，最後落到運轉協調與驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Built around the mesospheric sodium layer near 90 km and the four 22 W sodium lasers of ESO's VLT 4LGSF, this course goes from the D2 absorption cross-section to returned photons per square metre per second, then handles the cone effect, the tip-tilt a laser cannot measure, spot elongation, false defocus from sodium altitude and multi-laser cross-talk, ending with operational coordination and acceptance records.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」與「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" and "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「中氣層鈉原子層」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mesospheric sodium layer” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。把雷射調到鈉 D2 線 589.16 nm，鈉原子吸收後自發輻射，向各方向發出同波長的光，從地面看就像一顆位於 90 km 的人造星。鈉原子溫度約 190 K，都卜勒展寬約 1 GHz，遠大於約 10 MHz 的自然線寬，所以雷射的線寬、頻率準確度與偏振直接決定能激發多少原子。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中氣層鈉原子層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. A laser tuned to the sodium D2 line at 589.16 nm is absorbed and re-emitted spontaneously in all directions at the same wavelength, so from the ground it looks like an artificial star at 90 km. At about 190 K the sodium Doppler width is near 1 GHz, far larger than the roughly 10 MHz natural linewidth, so the laser's linewidth, frequency accuracy and polarisation directly decide how many atoms are excited. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mesospheric sodium layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「中氣層鈉原子層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mesospheric sodium layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面
knowledge.text: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。把雷射調到鈉 D2 線 589.16 nm，鈉原子吸收後自發輻射，向各方向發出同波長的光，從地面看就像一顆位於 90 km 的人造星。
knowledge.textEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. A laser tuned to the sodium D2 line at 589.16 nm is absorbed and re-emitted spontaneously in all directions at the same wavelength, so from the ground it looks like an artificial star at 90 km.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" is correct?
options: 鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。
流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。
有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。
optionsEn: The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back.

Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night.
With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all.
quiz.explanation: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中氣層鈉原子層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mesospheric sodium layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻² 時光學厚度 τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038，也就是窄頻低強度下只有約 4% 的雷射光子被鈉層吸收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm². With a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻² the optical depth τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038, so a narrowband low-intensity laser loses only about 4% of its photons to the sodium layer. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section", which statement holds?
options: 鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。
LGS 的焦距只隨天頂角改變，鈉層本身的高度是固定的。
optionsEn: Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.
LGS focus changes only with zenith angle; the sodium layer altitude is fixed.
The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz.
quiz.explanation: D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「中氣層鈉原子層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Mesospheric sodium layer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section"?
options: 以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。
optionsEn: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other.
quiz.explanation: 以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中氣層鈉原子層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Mesospheric sodium layer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鈉原子溫度約 190 K，都卜勒展寬約 1 GHz，遠大於約 10 MHz 的自然線寬，所以雷射的線寬、頻率準確度與偏振直接決定能激發多少原子。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At about 190 K the sodium Doppler width is near 1 GHz, far larger than the roughly 10 MHz natural linewidth, so the laser's linewidth, frequency accuracy and polarisation directly decide how many atoms are excited.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。
knowledge.textEn: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高。
有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises.
With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all.
quiz.explanation: 雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser cone and turbulent layers” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐；高度 h 的湍流層只被半徑縮小為 (1 − h/H) 的部分取樣，邊緣的湍流沒被量到，這就是錐效應，也稱焦點非等暈。導引星越低、口徑越大，問題越嚴重。此外雷射上行與回波下行穿過同一段大氣，導引星在天空的位置抖動同時包含上行與下行的傾斜，兩者無法分離，所以整體 tip-tilt 必須另由一顆自然星量測。瑞利導引星利用 10 到 20 km 高的空氣分子散射，亮度高，但錐效應遠比鈉導引星嚴重，多用於地表層自適應光學。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil; a layer at height h is sampled only over a region shrunk by (1 − h/H), leaving turbulence at the edge unmeasured, which is the cone effect or focal anisoplanatism, worse for lower beacons and larger apertures. The laser also travels up and the return comes down through the same air, so the beacon's position jitter on the sky mixes uplink and downlink tilt that cannot be separated, and overall tip-tilt must come from a natural star. Rayleigh beacons use molecular scattering at 10 to 20 km and are bright, but their cone effect is far worse than sodium's, so they mainly serve ground-layer adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser cone and turbulent layers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser cone and turbulent layers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性
knowledge.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy
knowledge.text: 自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐；高度 h 的湍流層只被半徑縮小為 (1 − h/H) 的部分取樣，邊緣的湍流沒被量到，這就是錐效應，也稱焦點非等暈。導引星越低、口徑越大，問題越嚴重。
knowledge.textEn: Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil; a layer at height h is sampled only over a region shrunk by (1 − h/H), leaving turbulence at the edge unmeasured, which is the cone effect or focal anisoplanatism, worse for lower beacons and larger apertures. The laser also travels up and the return comes down through the same air, so the beacon's position jitter on the sky mixes uplink and downlink tilt that cannot be separated, and overall tip-tilt must come from a natural star.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy" is correct?
options: 有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。
只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。
自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐。
optionsEn: With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all.
Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil.
quiz.explanation: 自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐；高度 h 的湍流層只被半徑縮小為 (1 − h/H) 的部分取樣，邊緣的湍流沒被量到，這就是錐效應，也稱焦點非等暈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil; a layer at height h is sampled only over a region shrunk by (1 − h/H), leaving turbulence at the edge unmeasured, which is the cone effect or focal anisoplanatism, worse for lower beacons and larger apertures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser cone and turbulent layers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。對 h = 5 km 的層，鈉導引星與 12 km 瑞利導引星的取樣直徑分別為 7.74 m 與 4.78 m，說明瑞利星只能有效修正最低層湍流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim. For a layer at h = 5 km the sampled diameters are 7.74 m for sodium and 4.78 m for a 12 km Rayleigh beacon, which is why Rayleigh beacons correct only the lowest turbulence effectively. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。對 h = 5 km 的層，鈉導引星與 12 km 瑞利導引星的取樣直徑分別為 7.74 m 與 4.78 m，說明瑞利星只能有效修正最低層湍流。
knowledge.textEn: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim. For a layer at h = 5 km the sampled diameters are 7.74 m for sodium and 4.78 m for a 12 km Rayleigh beacon, which is why Rayleigh beacons correct only the lowest turbulence effectively.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy", which statement holds?
options: 8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m。
LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。
雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。
optionsEn: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide.
LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged.
More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other.
quiz.explanation: 8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser cone and turbulent layers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Confirm tilt indeterminacy by showing that the global tilt reported by the LGS is nearly uncorrelated with the NGS tilt. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Confirm tilt indeterminacy by showing that the global tilt reported by the LGS is nearly uncorrelated with the NGS tilt.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變。
雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions.
Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination.
quiz.explanation: 以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser cone and turbulent layers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：瑞利導引星利用 10 到 20 km 高的空氣分子散射，亮度高，但錐效應遠比鈉導引星嚴重，多用於地表層自適應光學。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rayleigh beacons use molecular scattering at 10 to 20 km and are bright, but their cone effect is far worse than sodium's, so they mainly serve ground-layer adaptive optics.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。
若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement.
quiz.explanation: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
